label: verify-bm-clients-and-market

claims.claim: Smart grants are closed; KTP, SBIR/STTR and Royce ICP are the live routes.
claims.source_says: Smart grants are now closed for new applications as funding is being aligned to Innovate UK’s new strategic direction.
claims.note: Smart closure confirmed, but the agent's own file says KTP round one is closed and Royce eligibility was not read, so 'live' is overstated and not checked here.

claims.claim: SBIR needs a US-owned for-profit; STTR needs a research partner; Phase I ceiling USD 335,937, Phase II USD 2,239,578 as of 16 Oct 2026; apply page shows USD 323,000.
claims.source_says: As of October 16, 2026, agencies may issue a Phase I award (including modifications) up to $335,937 and a Phase II award ... up to $2,239,578 without seeking SBA approval.
claims.note: All parts reproduced on about and apply pages, including the older $50,000-$323,000 figure.

claims.claim: Clients pay for finished installations (Hyundai via Tate, Neko Health, COS, Buro Happold); Fab.Pub has a material-intake door and GBP 250 minimum budget; no fees published.
claims.source_says: Send us the material source, approximate volume and the product or application you have in mind. / Total Budget (Minimum Budget: £250)
claims.note: Fab.Pub door, GBP 250 and Hyundai partnership confirmed; Neko, COS and Buro Happold client pages not opened by me and 'no fees published' is a negative.

claims.claim: No evidence that any facade manufacturer or Formlabs pays outsiders for material R&D; Schueco offers non-financial resources, Formlabs in-kind consumables and certification.
claims.source_says: Sometimes it’s about gaining access to non-financial resources.
claims.note: Schueco sentence confirmed (fetch returned only the second half of the quote); the Formlabs part and the negative finding were not checked.

overall: The SBIR figures and the Smart-grants closure reproduce exactly. The Fab.Pub, Hyundai and Schueco quotes are real. The 'live routes' wording, the other named clients, the Formlabs part and the 'no evidence found' conclusions were not confirmed.
